comment: Gold-log regression fingerprints (scripts/goldlog.browser.js, harness v2.2). The harness seeds Math.random (mulberry32), virtualizes Date.now onto the pump grid, bypasses the visual draft with FIXED teams (the draft's greedy chooser jitters every candidate with rng, so title-screen cosmetics would cascade into different teams), reseeds at game entry, waits out the real-async jersey loader on a 50ms pump grid, and samples every 50ms step. Fingerprint = SHA-256 of the state-transition log (dash-grouped). Behavior-identical phases must reproduce these exactly. To debug a mismatch: check out the anchoring commit and re-run goldLogRun for the full log. CAUTION when regenerating: launch goldLogRun fire-and-forget and poll sessionStorage('goldlog_last') afterward — an awaited eval that times out mid-drive interleaves CDP work with the run and pollutes the fingerprint.
capturedAt: MAIN RE-CAPTURED 2026-07-29 on feat/outfield-relay (the cutoff relay; kid verified unchanged behind the manualBaserunning gate). | BOTH RE-CAPTURED 2026-07-28 on fix/fielder-runner-speed-ratio (LIVE.FIELDER_RUN_RATIO: fielders 2.48x -> 1.0x runner speed, kid cpuFielderSpeedMult 0.62 -> 1.3, plus the two latent sim bugs that surfaced -- see fielderRatioRecapture). Each verified byte-stable across two clean runs. | Earlier lineage: post live-play fielding+baserunning fixes (chaser election moved to systems/fielding.ts and can change hands mid-play; loose-ball settles clamp into the field; batter-runners can no longer be turned back toward the plate), main re-captured 2026-07-25 on feat/pitch-ceremony to correct the drift #24 left behind (see mainDrift), main re-captured 2026-07-26 on feat/pitch-corridor-remeasure.

main.note: fixed teams A/B, 1 inning + bonus, ends 0-0 through the bonus 2nd. RECAPTURED 2026-07-29 for the cutoff relay (LIVE.RELAY): a CPU fielder who secures the ball beyond 1.39 basepath legs now relays it in through a cutoff man instead of throwing at a bag, so a ball that reaches the outfield is a hit. 5606 -> 5351. Verified byte-identical across two clean runs.

kid.note: fixed teams A/B, 1 inning + bonus, ends 1-0 in the bonus 2nd. UNCHANGED by the 2026-07-29 cutoff relay -- VERIFIED, not assumed, by re-running the harness: the relay is gated on params.manualBaserunning, so kid mode never reaches the branch and draws no extra rng. That gate exists partly for this reason; without it an extra relay leg would draw from cpuThrowErrorMs and regenerate this log for a mode that gained nothing. RECAPTURED 2026-07-28. Note the shape of this one: the LENGTH and the final score are UNCHANGED from the pre-ratio 335f3ca0, but the hash moved -- kid mode's absolute CPU fielder speed barely shifted (65.7 -> 55.6px/s, since its old 0.62 mult was cancelling most of the bad base), so the game plays out along nearly the same transition skeleton with a few different outcomes inside it. Same length is NOT evidence of no change; always compare the hash. Verified byte-identical across two clean runs.

fielderRatioRecapture.why: LIVE.FIELDER_SPEED 106 -> 42.8 (ratio 2.48x -> 1.0x) and MODES.kid.live.cpuFielderSpeedMult 0.62 -> 1.3. Squarely on the seeded rng path: the change decides WHETHER outs happen, not merely when, so both logs had to move. See scripts/measures.json defense.fielderSpeed.
fielderRatioRecapture.alsoInThisCapture: Two latent sim bugs the slower fielders exposed, both of which change state transitions in their own right: (1) liveplay.ts catchGatherFor -- the CPU may now throw behind a retreating runner without waiting the full sac-fly gather beat, so doubling off works by THROW instead of by the carrier footracing the runner for a tag; (2) the maxPlayMs straggler settle now uses min(from, to), so a runner turned back from the plate can no longer settle standing on home unscored and vanish from the inning.
fielderRatioRecapture.methodValidated: Before recording these, the harness was re-run on a STASHED (baseline) tree and reproduced the previously recorded kid fingerprint 335f3ca0.../10756 exactly. That is what makes the new numbers comparable to the old ones rather than merely self-consistent -- it proves the hashing method and the drive procedure both match the ones that produced the recorded values. Worth repeating on any recapture.
fielderRatioRecapture.procedureNote: The comment above says to launch fire-and-forget and poll; two further traps found here. (1) goldLogPrepare() calls location.reload(), which DESTROYS the eval'd harness -- goldLogRun must be re-eval'd in a fresh eval AFTER the reload, and launching it in the same eval as goldLogPrepare silently does nothing. (2) An in-page busy-wait (`while (!done) await sleep(500)`) is exactly the awaited eval the caution warns about -- it times out at 45s mid-drive. Poll with separate, cheap property reads instead.

REGENERATED.why: Clears the STALE flag set on 2026-07-24. Those fingerprints encoded the PRE-RETUNE pace; these are captured against the retuned pace AND the fielding/baserunning fixes, so the gate is meaningful again.
REGENERATED.caveat: defense.* in scripts/measures.json is still scaled-not-measured, and the chaser election added here is new defense behaviour that has NOT had a feel-tuning pass. If the defense is later tuned (start with LIVE.CHASE.CUTOFF_GRACE_MS, then the leashes), these will need regenerating again — that is expected, not a regression.

mainDrift.what: The main fingerprint had been silently invalid since #24 (Match Backyard's pitch). #24 changed PITCH_SPEED and every swing window without regenerating, so the recorded 2568/b4463dd2 described a build that no longer existed -- the gate would have failed for the next person to run it, and read as their fault. Corrected here to 3038/b7377201.
mainDrift.attribution: NOT caused by the ceremony PR that lands this fix. Verified by driving the harness on two checkouts: post-#24 src (old swing-card gate present, ceremonyThen absent -- asserted in the tab before the drive) and the ceremony branch. Both produce 3038/b7377201 byte for byte. The ceremony fills a beat the game already waited out, so it moves no state transition.
mainDrift.kidUnaffected: kid held at 10756/335f3ca0 throughout -- #24's pitch corridor is CLASSIC-only and the ceremony is mode-blind. Re-verified, not assumed.
mainDrift.lesson: A gate nobody runs is a gate nobody notices breaking. #24 touched constants squarely on the seeded rng path and skipped the goldlog step the delivery process calls for. Run it when the diff touches PACE, not only when it touches the sim.
